name: Greater Believer’s Channel
body:
Your channeling power touched its apex.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 17, Believer’s Boon, Believer’s Channel, Improved Believer’s Channel, character level 19th, alignment must be within one step of your deity’s.

Benefit(s): Your channel energy ability improves to that of a cleric of your character level – 2.

The Bardess’ Library #22: Virtues, © 2026, Legendary Games; Author: Margherita Tramontano.
